name: Half-timbered townhouse (jettied)
description: Norman town house, 10.4 x 8.4 m: a rubble-stone ground floor (shop room) under two half-timbered storeys, each jettied 35 cm further out over the street and the yard on oak bressummers and joist ends, under a steep tiled gable roof with a brick chimney. Two stairs, a rear corridor on every floor, parlour and bedroom above.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core A: level 1 up to the half landing
core B: level 2 down to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
